readme:
## Overview

[AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html) helps you protect sensitive information, such as database credentials, API keys, and other secrets, by securely storing and managing access to them.

The AWS Secrets Manager connector provides APIs to interact with AWS Secrets Manager, enabling developers to programmatically manage secrets, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting secrets in their applications.

### Key Features

- Securely store and manage sensitive information
- Programmatically create, retrieve, update, and delete secrets
- Integration with AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
- Support for secret rotation and lifecycle management

## Setup guide
Before using this connector in your Ballerina application, complete the following:
1. Create an [AWS account](https://portal.aws.amazon.com/billing/signup?nc2=h_ct&src=default&redirect_url=https%3A%2F%2Faws.amazon.com%2Fregistration-confirmation#/start)
2. [Obtain tokens](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_access-keys.html)

## Quickstart

To use the `aws.secretmanager` connector in your Ballerina project, modify the `.bal` file as follows:

### Step 1: Import the module

Import the `ballerinax/aws.secretmanager` module into your Ballerina project.

```ballerina
import ballerinax/aws.secretmanager;
```

### Step 2: Instantiate a new connector

Create a new `secretmanager:Client` by providing the access key ID, secret access key, and the region.

```ballerina
configurable string accessKeyId = ?;
configurable string secretAccessKey = ?;

secretmanager:Client secretmanager = check new(region = secretmanager:US_EAST_1, auth = {
    accessKeyId,
    secretAccessKey
});
```

### Step 3: Invoke the connector operation

Now, utilize the available connector operations.

```ballerina
secretmanager:DescribeSecretResponse response = check secretManager->describeSecret("<secret-id>");
```

### Step 4: Run the Ballerina application

Use the following command to compile and run the Ballerina program.

```bash
bal run
```

typeDefs.description: Represents the request parameters for the `batchGetSecretValue` API of the AWS Secrets Manager connector.

fields.description: The filters to choose which secrets to retrieve

annotations.value: { maxLength: { value: 10, message: "Can only have maximum 10 filters per request" } }

fields.name: maxResults
fields.description:
The number of results to include in the response. If there are more results available, 
in the response, Secrets Manager includes `nextToken`. To use this parameter, 
you must also use the `filters` parameter

if a previous call did not show all results

typeDefs.name: BatchGetSecretValueResponse
typeDefs.description: Represents the response returned by the `batchGetSecretValue` API of the AWS Secrets Manager connector.

fields.name: errors
fields.description:
A list of errors encountered by Secrets Manager while attempting to retrieve individual secrets.
Each error provides details such as the error code, message, and the affected secret's identifier.

fields.name: nextToken
fields.description:
A token indicating that more results are available than what is included in the current response. 
Use this token to retrieve the next set of results by making another call to `batchGetSecretValue`. 
This token might be present even if no values are returned, such as when filtering a long list

fields.name: secretValues
fields.description: A list of retrieved secret values. Each value represents a specific secret returned by the API.

fields.name: message
fields.description: A descriptive message explaining the nature of the error.

fields.name: secretId
fields.description: The ARN or name of the secret for which the error occurred.

functions.name: describeSecret
functions.description:
Retrieves the details of a secret. It does not include the encrypted secret value. 
Secrets Manager only returns fields that have a value in the response. 
```ballerina
secretmanager:DescribeSecretResponse response = check secretmanager->describeSecret("<aws-secret-id>");
```

parameters.name: secretId
parameters.description: The ARN or name of the secret

return.description:
An `secretmanager:DescribeSecretResponse` containing the details of the secret, 
or an `secretmanager:Error` if the request validation or the operation failed

functions.name: getSecretValue
functions.description:
Retrieves the contents of the encrypted fields from the specified version of a secret.
```ballerina
secretmanager:SecretValue secret = check secretmanager->getSecretValue("<aws-secret-id>");
```

parameters.name: secretId
parameters.description: The ARN or name of the secret

parameters.name: versionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the version of the secret

parameters.name: versionStage
parameters.description: The staging label of the version of the secret

parameters.name: versionSelector
parameters.description: Details for selecting a specific version of the secret

return.description:
An `secretmanager:SecretValue` containing the content of the secret, or an 
`secretmanager:Error` if the request validation or the operation failed

functions.name: batchGetSecretValue
functions.description:
Retrieves the contents of the encrypted fields for up to 20 secrets.
```ballerina
secretmanager:BatchGetSecretValueResponse secret = check secretmanager->batchGetSecretValue(
   secretIds = ["<aws-secret-id>"]);
```

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: The filters to choose which secrets to retrieve

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description:
The number of results to include in the response. If there are more results available, 
in the response, Secrets Manager includes `nextToken`. To use this parameter, 
you must also use the `filters` parameter

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description:
A token that indicates where the output should continue from, 
if a previous call did not show all results

parameters.name: secretIds
parameters.description: The ARN or names of the secrets to retrieve. You must include `filters` or `secretIds`, but not both

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The filters or secret IDs used to identify the secrets to retrieve

return.description:
An `secretmanager:BatchGetSecretValueResponse` containing the contents of the secrets, or an 
`secretmanager:Error` if the request validation or the operation failed

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the AWS Secret Manager client resources.
```ballerina
check secretmanager->close();
```

return.description: A `secretmanager:Error` if there is an error while closing the client resources or else nil
